subtitles.en: The financial health of U.S. public schools keeps getting worse.
subtitles.zh: 美国公立学校的财务状况持续承压。

subtitles.en: This is according to S&P Global Ratings. Their performance turned negative across all ratings categories last year.
subtitles.zh: 根据标普全球评级的数据，去年所有评级类别的表现均转为负面。

subtitles.en: For the first time since the pandemic, Bloomberg's Aaron Hudson joins us now.
subtitles.zh: 这是疫情以来首次出现这种情况。彭博的Aaron Hudson现在加入我们。

subtitles.en: So how bad is this financial picture here? Yeah, it's deteriorating.
subtitles.zh: 那么这里的财务状况有多糟糕？是的，正在承压。

subtitles.en: That's the big takeaway from this report and that analysts expect the credit pressure is only going to be continuing to be at this level.
subtitles.zh: 这是报告的主要结论，分析师预计信贷压力只会继续维持在当前水平。

subtitles.en: So it really, what this report tells us is that there's a real shift in the landscape of K-12 education, particularly public school districts.
subtitles.zh: 这份报告真正告诉我们的是，K-12教育领域，尤其是公立学区，正在发生真正的转变。

subtitles.en: And a few of those metrics, like all of financial performance, turning negative across all rating categories, that really tells us this is a broad systemic issue
subtitles.zh: 其中一些指标，比如所有评级类别的财务表现均转为负面，这确实告诉我们这是一个广泛的系统性问题。

subtitles.en: that's affecting all types of schools. So you've got the top rated schools seeing these challenges and then also the lowest rated.
subtitles.zh: 它影响着所有类型的学校。所以顶级评级的学校面临这些挑战，最低评级的学校也是如此。

subtitles.en: The other big metric is the operating deficits.
subtitles.zh: 另一个重要指标是运营赤字。

subtitles.en: So half of the school districts reported operating deficits, spending more than they're taking in.
subtitles.zh: 一半的学区报告了运营赤字，支出超过收入。
en_highlights: spending more than they're taking in

subtitles.en: And that's a worsening the year prior.
It was about a third of the school districts. So I guess this is a question that may not, it sounds disingenuous, but it's not.
subtitles.zh: 当时约三分之一的学区如此。所以这个问题听起来可能不真诚，但并非如此。

subtitles.en: But why are school districts suddenly under so much pressure?
subtitles.zh: 但为什么学区突然面临如此大的压力？

subtitles.en: I mean, or this has been building for a while, but the ratings companies were kind of late to mark them down.
subtitles.zh: 我的意思是，这已经积累了一段时间，但评级公司下调评级有点晚。

subtitles.en: Yeah, so there's a few factors at play here.
subtitles.zh: 是的，所以这里有几个因素在起作用。

subtitles.en: So the suddenness in a way is kind of the leg of some of the impacts of the pandemic.
subtitles.zh: 所以这种突然性在某种程度上是疫情一些影响的体现。

clip_research.source_claim: Half of the school districts reported operating deficits, spending more than they're taking in, and financial performance turned negative across all rating categories.
clip_research.public_baseline: S&P Global Ratings' September report found about half of U.S. school districts running operating deficits in 2025, up from 33% in 2024, with all rating categories in negative territory for the first time since the pandemic and negative outlooks up 40% between June 2024 and June 2025.
clip_research.surprise_gap: The deterioration is broad-based rather than confined to weak districts: both top-rated and lowest-rated districts are affected, and the share of districts with operating deficits jumped from roughly one-third to one-half in a single year.
